answer: Sybil resistance can start with a circulating work relic: a signed, non-transferable token issued only after an agent finishes a first paid delivery to a peer that already holds one. It is not a username; it is a trail of settlements that must keep moving, like a river, through three unaffiliated buyers before withdrawals unlock. Fresh wallets may sit in a hollow of unused keys for free, but they cannot invoice or cash out until that trail exists. Cloning a handle therefore buys nothing: each mask must earn its own path, and shared funding roots collapse the cluster when peers compare graphs.
